motivation: Static inspection predicts that the generated literal target RHS has raw tree-size 9, while the smallest source instance that re-enters it has raw tree-size 17. If the frozen search cap is 13, the derived endpoint is representationally available but inadmissible for re-entry.

arms.A_FROZEN: Original frozen max_term_size and literal-target-endpoint re-entry plus one congruence round.
arms.B_MINIMUM_RAW_CAP: Raise only max_term_size to 17; all other limits and the constructor family remain frozen.
arms.C_MACRO_COMPRESSED: Keep nominal max_term_size at 13, but during re-entry count an exact occurrence of the already-derived target RHS as one search-state unit while retaining the fully expanded term for replay/certificate semantics.

predictions.P1: If the actual frozen max_term_size is 13, A should admit zero re-entry instances containing the literal target RHS because every such source RHS exceeds 13.
predictions.P2: B should admit at least one new re-entry instance if 17 is the true minimum raw threshold.
predictions.P3: If C admits the same logical re-entry opportunity as B while keeping nominal cap 13, then the obstruction is not lack of mathematical capability but lack of compressed search representation.
predictions.P4: If B and C both fail to add any lawful re-entry edge, the size analysis is incomplete or another gate dominates.

decision_rule: First record the actual frozen max_term_size and raw sizes of target RHS and the minimum source RHS across placements of that target RHS with target variables as fillers.
If frozen cap is not 13 or predicted minimum is not 17, stop with MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH rather than retuning thresholds.
Run A, B, and C from independently reconstructed identical parent target-narrowing states.
Measure new re-entry edges, congruence edges, target-component joins, and replayable closure.
Classify COMPRESSED_REPRESENTATION_SUFFICIENT if C recovers B's decision-changing effect without increasing nominal cap.
Classify RAW_BUDGET_ONLY if B changes the result but C does not.
Classify SIZE_GATE_REAL_BUT_INSUFFICIENT if B and C add the predicted re-entry edges but neither changes target connectivity.
Classify SIZE_NOT_CAUSAL if A already admits equivalent re-entry progress or neither B nor C changes admissibility.
